scripts.main: bun build src/main.ts src/preload.ts --target=node --format=cjs --external electron --outdir dist --entry-naming [name].cjs
scripts.server: bun build --compile --minify --external 'chromium-bidi' --external 'chromium-bidi/*' --external playwright-core ../server/src/main.ts --outfile build/zorel-server && bun scripts/playwright.ts
scripts.start: bun run --cwd ../web build && bun run main && electron .
scripts.prebuild: bun run --cwd ../web build && rm -rf build && mkdir build && cp -R ../web/dist build/web && cp -R ../server/drizzle build/drizzle && bun run server && bun run browser && bun run licenses && bun run main
scripts.prerelease: bun run --cwd ../web build && rm -rf build && mkdir build && cp -R ../web/dist build/web && cp -R ../server/drizzle build/drizzle && bun run server && bun run browser && bun run licenses && bun run main
scripts.browser: PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=build/browsers bun ../server/node_modules/playwright-core/cli.js install chromium-headless-shell && rm -rf build/browsers/ffmpeg-*
